newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Dong Ah assured $5.1 bln Libya order.
newsitem.headline: Dong Ah assured $5.1 bln Libya order.

text.p: South Korea's Dong Ah Construction Industrial Co said on Monday it had been recently assured by the Libyan government that it would receive a $5.1 billion contract for the third phase of the Great Man-Made River project.

"Libyan leader Muammar Gaddafi on November 18 issued a letter of intent on the third phase of Libya's Great Man-Made River project to Dong Ah group chairman Choi Won-suk," a statement from Dong Ah said.
The letter was issued by the Minister of Great Man-made River Project, the statement said.
Although there had been verbal assuances by the Libyan government, the letter was the first official document confirming Dong Ah would be awarded the contract, it added.
Dong Ah has already participated in the first two phases of the project, together worth $10.2 billion, the statement said.
The third phase, which involves building 1,268 km of waterways in seven different areas, is expected to take about 10 years for completion, it added.
